criteria.criterion: 1. Fixture replay and SSE client share an interface; tested with fake EventSource
criteria.evidence: dashboard/lib/sources.ts: both return EventSourceAdapter {start, close}; tests/sources.test.tsx 'same interface' with FakeES.

criteria.criterion: 2. Invalid events skipped and reported in UI
criteria.evidence: lib/validate.ts + runReducer errors; tests 'validateEvent accepts fixture, rejects bad shapes', 'ignores invalid events with a visible error'.

criteria.criterion: 3. Disconnect shows status, no infinite retry
criteria.evidence: maxRetries default 3; tests 'shows disconnected after bounded retries', 'successful open resets the retry counter; run_finished closes', 'reports missing EventSource instead of crashing'.

non_blocking: Tests only use fake EventSource; not verified against real backend SSE (dev-03 or later integration).
validateEvent checks envelope by hand and may drift from docs/schema/events.json; consider a schema-comparison test.
Retry reset on onopen: a server that repeatedly opens then errors never hits the limit (acceptable).

tests_rerun.command: uv run pytest -q (plus python3 .autodev/verify.py incl. vitest)

summary: Shared SSE/fixture event source, schema validation and bounded reconnect all have real tests; verify clean, pytest 226 pass; events.json untouched.
